data.title: Lisk: Bridge initiation window closes for transfers to Ethereum - 24 Oct 2026
data.description: Lisk users have until 24 October 2026 to start bridging assets from Lisk Chain to Ethereum. The bridge process takes about eight days, and every withdrawal must be claimed on Ethereum by the end of 2 November.The deadline applies to assets including LSK.
